notes: REAL student handwriting, held out. One page from data/asap/Handwritten ASAP SAS/prompt-3 (Gold & Zesch, ICFHR 2020), none of the four images build_full_papers.py already uses. Question 1 is the genuine ASAP-SAS set 3 prompt; questions 2 and 3 were added so a blank exists to be detected. The article extract is printed on the paper as material, which is the first time that path is tested on real handwriting. Marks were written from the dataset's own human transcription BEFORE any pipeline run, so this is truth about the writing and not about what was recognised. The ASAP human scores for these ids need a Kaggle login, so these are my marks against the article's two facts: what a specialist is and what a generalist is.

questions.key: Specialists depend on a narrow food source and a stable habitat -- the panda on bamboo, the koala on eucalyptus. One mark for the specialist constraint, one for both examples drawn from the article, one for the generalist contrast.
